articles.content:
Kristin Hannah’s best-selling historical fiction book The Nightingale will be made into a movie after all.

The project was first sparked before the COVID-19 pandemic, which slowed momentum on the making of the film. Now the movie has a theatrical release date set and a growing cast attached to the story.

For everything we know about The Nightingale movie, read on.

When will The Nightingale movie come out?

TriStar first set February 12, 2027 as the release date for the film, but then the adaptation was pushed to March 19 so that it has Easter weekend (March 28) to capitalize on. In Feb., the film would have competed with Greta Gerwig's Narnia film set to release that weekend as well. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article1-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid","mid-articleX","mid-article","300x251"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[2,2],[300,250],[620,350],[300,251],[501,282],[3,3],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366]]) .exemptFromSleep() .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Watch on Deadline if ( !window.pmc.harmony?.isEventAdScheduledTime() ) { pmcCnx.cmd.push(function() { pmcCnx({ settings: { plugins: { pmcAtlasMG: { iabPlcmt: 2, } } }, playerId: '32fe25c4-79aa-406a-af44-69b41e969e71', playlistId: '0199e506-e642-7728-8264-463efe71337b', }).render("connatix_contextual_player_div"); }); } else { // This should only be get called when page cache is not cleared and it's event time. window.pmc.harmony?.switchToHarmonyPlayer(); }

Is there a trailer for The Nightingale movie?

Yes, a trailer arrived Nov. 19 giving a glimpse of what the Fanning sisters' French characters will go through in the film .

Who will be in The Nightingale movie?

Sisters Dakota and Elle Fanning , who have been attached to star and produce since the adaptation started gaining traction in 2019, will portray sisters Vianne and Isabelle.

Deadline exclusively reported that Edmund Donovan ( Late Fame ) landed a starring role alongside the sisters in January 2026. Details of his role are under wraps.

Next to join as first reported by Deadline are Mark Rylance  ( The BFG, Ready Player One ) and  Shira Haas ( Unorthodox, Captain America: Brave New World ).

Deadline broke the news of a quartet of castings that round out the film's ensemble: Albrecht Schuch , Douglas Hodge, Gwilym Lee and Vinette Robinson.

What is Kristin Hannah’s The Nightingale about?

The story centers sisters Vianne Mauriac and Isabelle Rossignol, who experience German-occupied France during World War II in their own ways. Vianne, the older sister, is more cautious while Isabelle boasts a rebellious spirit. The sisters split up during the war, "resisting in different ways" as Fanning put it when she did Deadline's Take Ten interview series . blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dl-mid-article-inject2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article2","mid-articleX","mid-article","mid","300x251"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366]]) .exemptFromSleep() .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Who else is behind The Nightingale movie?

Michael Morris is directing the film. Dana Stevens ( The Woman King ) wrote the script for the film. Elizabeth Cantillon will produce for The Cantillon Company, alongside the Fannings and Brittany Kahan Ward for the Fanning sisters' production company Lewellen Pictures, and Reese Witherspoon and Lauren Neustadter for Hello Sunshine. The Nightingale was the Reese’s Book Club selection for March 2023. Nicole Brown and Shary Shirazi are overseeing for TriStar Pictures.

TriStar first acquired the film rights in 2015 with Ann Peacock attached to write. Writer-director Michelle MacLaren and co-writer John Sayles were involved in a later iteration, with the Fannings initially boarding to star in a version helmed by Mélanie Laurent from Stevens’ script . At first, the film was set to hit theaters Christmas Day of 2020, and then it shifted a few more times landing on Dec. 22, 2022 , but when the Covid pandemic kept delaying the making of the movie, Laurent stepped back to attend to other projects.

Has The Nightingale started production?

Yes, Kristin Hannah posted at the end of March that the film had started production. Elle Fanning did press for Margo's Got Money Troubles in April before the show's premiere on Apple TV, but she had hinted as had her sister Dakota, that they would start shooting in a few weeks when Deadline spoke with them at SXSW Film Festival 2026.

Deadline also interviewed Lauren Neustadter , President of Film and Television at Reese Witherspoon's Production Company Hello Sunshine while she was on set in Budapest, where the film is shooting.

articles.title: A Teen’s Make-A-Wish Dream Was To Be In A Hallmark Movie. She Got To Do That And So Much More
articles.summary: What a magical wish!
articles.content:
What do Disney Parks, Make-A-Wish, and the Hallmark Channel all have in common? They love making dreams come true, and that’s exactly what happened for one teenage Hallmark movie superfan who has dreamt about being in one of the cable channel’s movies for a very long time.

Both Ceci and her mom got to appear in what is apparently one of the major scenes in the holiday romance film, titled Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True . They can be seen as hotel guests, sitting in the lobby of Disney’s Polynesian Village Resort holding Minnie Mouse and Dumbo plushies. I know I’m definitely going to be keeping my eyes open for the mother-daughter duo when the movie premieres as part of the 2026 TV Schedule on the Hallmark Channel on November 28th at 8 p.m. ET.

Filming wrapped early this year on what could be Hallmark’s best Countdown to Christmas movie of 2026, but the magic hasn’t stopped for Ceci, who was surprised once again when her entire family was flown back out to Walt Disney World to attend the red-carpet premiere.

All of this is making me more excited for the film! Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True centers on Lindsey (Chabert), who plans to spend the holidays at Disney World with her extended family. In addition to having the best holiday ever, Lindsey also makes a wish at Cinderella’s Fountain for a love worthy of a fairytale to find her.

articles.title: How to Get a 6-Star Wanted Level in GTA 6 and Then Escape From the Cops
articles.summary: Courtesy of Rockstar Games Rockstar has brought back the fabled 6-Star wanted level in Grand Theft Auto 6, giving players an extra tier of notoriety that will pit every bit of law enforcement against them in all-out war. Reaching six stars is almost as hard as staying alive once you obtain it, as it requires you to constantly commit […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Rockstar has brought back the fabled 6-Star wanted level in Grand Theft Auto 6 , giving players an extra tier of notoriety that will pit every bit of law enforcement against them in all-out war. Reaching six stars is almost as hard as staying alive once you obtain it, as it requires you to constantly commit multiple heinous acts of mayhem in a row without getting killed. Those who do manage to obtain a sixth star will find that there is almost no point of return from it, unless they take drastic actions to stay under the radar until the inevitable.

Technically, there is no escape for having six stars in GTA 6 , as acquiring that status puts the entire region of Leonida against you, turning your whole map into a hostile zone. Unless you get killed, busted, or wasted in any way, you'll keep those six stars, which never fall down into 5-4 through the actions you'd usually do to lower that score. That being said, there are some strategies that can keep you alive during your six-star run, making everything else you do in the game more challenging, but creating a "living on the edge" style of criminal life the usual gameplay of GTA 6 doesn't always offer.

Getting six stars is only possible after you've progressed past the initial steps of GTA 6 's story, as the game doesn't allow you to become too notorious too fast. You have to work your way up the criminal ladder, so to speak, before the authorities will pay enough attention to you to grant you the highest wanted level the game has. However, once you have the right weapons and gear past the game's "tutorial" levels to do some real mayhem, the chance to reach six stars is always available. Much like past Grand Theft Auto games , the easiest ways to raise your wanted level is through deliberate, chaotic violence, rather than just petty crimes.

While you could ramp up your stars one at a time through various robberies, heists, or assaults on the streets, the quickest way to get a 6-Star level lies in killing a cop. Any police officer you kill automatically gets you three stars, sending police to the scene of the crime instantly. Through the police radio, you can hear your crime being called as backup begins to arrive. If you want six stars, stay in the area of the killed officer long enough to be recognized as the guilty party, then either try to escape or fight anyone who comes in to arrest you. There are other ways to get to 3-5 stars really fast in GTA 6 besides murder, including:

Once you have the higher star count you need, you simply need to cause more conflict to get to six. This could mean evading the cops who know your description for 20+ minutes, or using significant firepower to hold off others over a prolonged period of time. For example, you could go into the Mile Zero military base, steal a tank, gain 3-4 stars, then keep shooting enemies to get six stars within ten minutes. This will put you in a ton of danger, as killing different authorities will bring the city's wrath down on your character, but this does start the challenge a lot faster than most methods would allow.

Once you reach six stars, there's no turning back. Normally, wanted levels in GTA 6 are tied to another system in the game called Heat, which represents a regional way police track you through specific areas of the map. When you gain a star in one area, police and military there can link you to crimes that took place in that zone, tying you to events that took place. This could manifest when you rob a store, kill someone, or do something else illegal, and is represented in-game by your wanted stars turning red rather than white. Those with Heat on them will have pressure to play smart, removing evidence and escaping crime scenes to prevent themselves from being identified.

When you have six stars, you have Heat all the time, whether you like it or not. Everyone will know exactly who you are and what you've done, due to the severity of your actions. Tracking evidence hardly matters in this state, as it'll be pretty clear who is the one causing the most chaos on the map after you do enough to be recognized with six stars. While lower stars will only create circular zones of Heat based on where crimes happened, six stars will turn the whole map into an active Heat area, preventing you from fleeing to one place to drop the wanted level.

While your Heat and stars can't go down once you get six stars, there are ways to avoid the pressure that comes with being Leonida's most wanted. Much like with lower stars, you can discard clothing from the scene of a crime, escape hostile forces, and lay low in an attempt to get away. Having both Jason and Lucia in these situations helps, as you can both eliminate more enemies following you with the support you provide to one another. Surviving is the key challenge here, as the full police force and military will be coming after you with everything they got once the 6-Star milestone has been hit.

While long multiplayer runs of GTA 6 on six stars isn't possible yet, the close monitoring from AI-controlled enemies during this state can create an interesting "Hard mode" that's even more difficult on a solo playthrough. There are no cheats to lower your wanted level, so to evade attention, you have to break enemy line of sight and not do any other crimes to disappear. Hiding your weapons can be a good strategy, but since cops and military enemies will be trying to deal with you using lethal force, you may want to have some back up guns. Changing vehicles and destroying evidence through cameras is also necessary to stay alive during this state.

Inevitably, you will be taken down with the highest amount of stars in the game, resetting your wanted level and causing you to lose resources in the process. However, accomplishing any missions or other content in this state is truly impressive, as you will be constantly fighting against impossible odds. For something like Grand Theft Auto 6 , that challenge can be all players need, making a 6-Star wanted level an achievement unlike any others in the game.

How will you try to get six stars for your wanted level in GTA 6 ? Let us know in the comments below!

articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google The story of Henry Cavill's time as Superman will forever be bittersweet for a lot of DC movie fans. Cavill seemed custom-made for the role of Clark Kent/Superman, but director Zack Snyder's Man of Steel (2012) was seen as a divisive introduction to the character. Even though fans generally accepted (if not enjoyed) Cavill as Superman, Snyder's subsequent film, Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice , made things even more divisive – and that's when things got weird.

After years of debacle getting him into a proper Justice League movie, it looked like Henry Cavill was done with the DC Extended Universe franchise for good. Then Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson gave fans the false hope that Cavill was about to enter a whole new era of being Superman, thanks to the now-infamous post-credits scene of Johnson's DC film, Black Adam . Cavill never suited up as Superman after that, but now you can at least get a behind-the-scenes look at the last time he put on the Superman suit to film his Black Adam cameo.

I saw that #HenryCavill was trending so I thought I'd add my connection to him. I've only ever worked with him once & only for about 3 hours. I only shot 1 scene with him, but it was pretty iconic. Would he make a good #jamesbond007 ? Maybe, but he made a brilliant Man of Steel. pic.twitter.com/34NYOYkSr5

Cinematographer Steven Hall posted a fond memory of when he worked with Henry Cavill on Black Adam . In his post he writes "I saw that #HenryCavill was trending so I thought I'd add my connection to him. I've only ever worked with him once & only for about 3 hours. I only shot 1 scene with him, but it was pretty iconic. Would he make a good #jamesbond007 ? Maybe, but he made a brilliant Man of Steel."

Cavill name is one that regularly goes viral on social media, whether it's fans talking about one of the new projects he's attached to ( Voltron, Highlander, Warhammer 40,000 ) or the never-ending debates about his previous roles as Superman or The Witcher protagonist Geralt of Rivia. He's also spent years being regularly mentioned in discussions about the next James Bond, ever since talk of Daniel Craig's successor began. Now Batman actor Robert Pattinson is the new Bond – casting news that has resonated all across the world. While early signs point to fans overwhelmingly approving of Robert Pattinson as James Bond, Cavill's name has once again been dragged up as a popular alternate choice. That's led these deeper looks back at his time as Superman and how it went awry.

The current future of DC Universe movies is unclear after major shakeups at DC Studios (following the merger between Skydance and Warner Bros. However, James Gunn still has one last project, his Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow , coming out next year. Actor David Corenswet is fully locked into his role as the DCU Superman, but some fans never give up hope that Henry Cavill will get another chance to suit up and play some alt-universe version (Ultraman) that Corenswet has to face. That's wishful thinking – biut then, we never thought that Black Adam would happen.

You can stream Black Adam and Henry Cavill's other Superman films on HBO Max.
